description: v1.5 Kalshi: a Kalshi pick’s link opens Kalshi’s board for the game (linkKind "game") and linkMarket names the one Kalshi market that is the bet and the side to buy: {ticker, side ("yes" | "no"), title (Kalshi’s own wording)}; linkMarket is null at every other book. v1.4 links: each pick’s link is the book’s own link rebuilt for the customer’s state, with linkKind ("bet" = the book opens with the bet in the slip, "game" = on the game’s page, null = no link) and linkNeedsState (true when the book has per-state sites only and the customer’s state is unknown); rules.bookLinks lists every book with opens ("bet" | "game" | null), needsState, and for Pro and up picks, betLinks, gameLinks on this answer. v1.3: each pick also carries fairPct (the Desk’s one fair chance for the bet) and evidence (the biggest thing that moved its Grade: line, top {what, direction, points, sourceName, sourceUrl, quote}) and contextLine (when nothing moved the Grade but it holds a quoted sentence code could not size for the bet, such as team news on a game total: that sentence with its source and link; null otherwise); the answer also holds arbitrage (sure-win pairs, see get_desk_arbitrage; optional total = dollars to split) and expired (picks whose edge is gone, see get_desk_expired). The Desk tab as the app reads it (GET desk). picks: the open Desk picks whose real Grade is B or better (B, B+, A-, A, A+), each with label, matchup, book, price, edge, paper stake in units, bet link and grade {letter, score, jobId, report: true}; picks with no Grade yet or a lower Grade are not on the Desk. Optional placed: pick ids the customer placed, returned as bets (open or settled) with their Grade whatever its letter. record: every settled Desk pick. Pro and up get the picks; Free and Starter get locked rows (league and start time only), the same count, and the record. Reads only; nothing is placed.

total.description: Dollars to split across the two bets of each arbitrage pair (default 100).
